why: I checked all six expect lines against the must_not item: no expect line may be checkable only on the published page or after merge. Four lines are CLI runs (`node bin/greet.js --shout Ada`, the flag after the name, the plain greeting, and no name exiting 2). One is `npm test` plus a grep of test/. All of these can be checked locally at the PR head. The docs line only requires that "docs/index.md documents the --shout option", and its proof says "Read docs/index.md at the PR head". It doesn't depend on the live site. The live site is mentioned only in the outcome ("will show it after the next deploy") and in non_goals, which says "Checking the live site... only happens after merge", so it is ruled out of verification. No expect line breaks the criterion.
